Subject: Inventory of discrepant evidence + next steps for Q3 calibration

Team —

Thanks again for yesterday’s calibration session. We surfaced a handful of people where ratings diverged more than our 1-band tolerance and a few where qualitative context changed the anchor. To move efficiently I want a tight inventory of concrete artifacts and proposed resolutions so I can adjudicate and get HR signoff this week.

Action request (deliver by 2pm PT today):
- For each discrepant individual (list below), add 1–3 primary artifacts that substantiate the manager’s recommended band (e.g., key PRs, customer feedback, support metrics, project lead evals). Name the artifact and give a 1–2 sentence rationale.
- Flag any persons where we expect an appeal or where documentation is incomplete.
- If you believe a cross-team adjustment is needed (e.g., market-level deflation/inflation), include a short note and the comparative peers you used.

Discrepant roster (excerpt):
- E1: A. Mendoza — engineering (backend infra) — manager recommended Band B, peer panel Band C
- P2: S. Ortega — product — manager Band A+, cross-team panel Band A
- D3: R. Chen — data science — panels split between B and C

Deliverables: one consolidated packet (PDF or zipped evidence) and a single-line proposed resolution per person. I’ll route to PeopleOps for final compliance and then to execs for sign-off.

Notes: keep language factual. Don’t include salary or compensation requests in the packet — separate thread if needed.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Product & Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference
